source_text: [and]-:C12 atha śrītantrāloke dvādaśamāhnikam athādhvano@sya prakṛta upayogaḥ prakāśyate itthamadhvā samasto@yaṃ yathā saṃvidi saṃsthitaḥ / taddvārā śūnyadhīprāṇanāḍīcakratanuṣvatho bahiśca liṅgamūrtyagnisthaṇḍilādiṣu sarvataḥ / tathā sthitaḥ samastaśca vyastaścaiṣa kramākramāt āsaṃvittattvamābāhyaṃ yo@yamadhvā vyavasthitaḥ / tatra tatrocitaṃ rūpaṃ svaṃ svātantryeṇa bhāsayet sarvaṃ sarvatra rūpaṃ ca tasyāpi na na bhāsate / nahyavaccheditāṃ kvāpi svapne@pi viṣahāmahe evaṃ viśvādhvasaṃpūrṇaṃ kālavyāpāracitritam / deśakālamayaspandasadma dehaṃ vilokayet tathā vilokyamāno@sau viśvāntardevatāmayaḥ / dhyeyaḥ pūjyaśca tarpyaśca tadāviṣṭo vimucyate itthaṃ ghaṭaṃ paṭaṃ liṅgaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ pustakaṃ jalam / yadvā kiṃcitkvacitpaśyettatra tanmayatāṃ vrajet tatrārpaṇaṃ hi vastūnāmabhedenārcanaṃ matam / tathā saṃpūrṇarūpatvānusaṃdhirdhyānamucyate saṃpūrṇatvānusaṃdhānamakampaṃ dārḍhyamānayan / tathāntarjalpayogena vimṛśañjapabhājanam

[and]-tatrārpitānāṃ bhāvānāṃ svakabhedavilāpanam / kurvaṃstadraśmisadbhāvaṃ dadyāddhomakriyāparaḥ tathaivaṃkurvataḥ sarvaṃ samabhāvena paśyataḥ / niṣkampatā vrataṃ śuddhaṃ sāmyaṃ nandiśikhoditam tathārcanajapadhyānahomavratavidhikramāt / paripūrṇāṃ sthitiṃ prāhuḥ samādhiṃ guravaḥ purā atra pūjājapādyeṣu bahirantardvayasthitau / dravyaughe na vidhiḥ ko@pi na kāpi pratiṣiddhatā kalpanāśuddhisaṃdhyādernopayogo@tra kaścana / uktaṃ śrītrikasūtre ca jāyate yajanaṃ prati avidhijño vidhijñaścetyevamādi suvistaram / yadā yathā yena yatra svā samvittiḥ prasīdati tadā tathā tena tatra tattadbhogyaṃ vidhiśca saḥ / laukikālaukikaṃ sarvaṃ tenātra viniyojayet niṣkampatve sakampastu kampaṃ nirhrāsayedbalāt / yathā yenābhyupāyena kramādakramato@pi vā vicikitsā galatyantastathāsau yatnavānbhavet / dhīkarmākṣagatā devīrniṣiddhaireva tarpayet vīravrataṃ cābhinandediti bhargaśikhāvacaḥ / tathāhi śaṅkā mālinyaṃ glāniḥ saṃkoca ityadaḥ

## tal-a12-p03

source_text: [and]-saṃsārakārāgārāntaḥ sthūlasthūṇāghaṭāyate / mantrā varṇasvabhāvā ye dravyaṃ yatpāñcabhautikam yaccidātma prāṇijātaṃ tatra kaḥ saṃkaraḥ katham / saṃkarābhāvataḥ keyaṃ śaṅkā tasyāmapi sphuṭam na śaṅketa tathā śaṅkā vilīyetāvahelayā / śrīsarvācāravīrālīniśācarakramādiṣu śāstreṣu vitataṃ caitattatra tatrocyate yataḥ / śaṅkayā jāyate glāniḥ śaṅkayā vighnabhājanam uvācotpaladevaśca śrīmānasmadgurorguruḥ / sarvāśaṅkāśaniṃ mārgaṃ numo māheśvaraṃ tviti anuttarapadāptaye tadidamāṇavaṃ darśitābhyupāyamativistarānnanu vidāṃkurudhvaṃ budhāḥ / [AbhT_12.26]
